 Android opens enrollment for app-store program bringing one-tap sideloading
 Tuesday, 27 October 2026, 21:41 
 Third-party app stores can sign up for Google’s new registration program, which will offer participating stores a streamlined installation flow starting December 1. 
 Google announced the program earlier this year. It follows a proposed settlement between Google and Epic Games last year, under which third-party app stores would be able to register officially with Android.
 This is reported by Android Authority .
 Google says enrollment in the Register App Stores program opened on October 27, 2026. Participation is optional. Stores that enroll will get a streamlined installation flow when it launches on December 1; stores that do not enroll will see no change to their installation process. The program is available to users outside the US on devices running Android 17 QPR2 or later.
